catalog_checked: 2026-09-30; KNMI open-data file listing for cesar_surface_meteo_lc1_t10 and cesar_surface_radiation_lc1_t10 v1.0, identical to results/weather_gapfilled_metadata.json
finding: 2021-2024 are not complete years in the lc1 catalog (2021 lacks Mar-Apr, 2022 Nov, 2023 Sep and Dec, 2024 seven months), so they cannot be formal campaign years. Complete untouched years are 2001-2011, 2015 and 2025.
boundary_hour: Campaign day 0 starts 31 Dec 23:00 UTC of the previous year. 2002-2011 take it from the previous December (2001-12 is included for 2002); 2015 from the cached 2014 development year. 2001 (no 2000 file) and 2025 (2024-12 missing) lack it and are listed only as options.

recommended.note: Eleven complete untouched years (2002-2011, 2015) plus the two 2001-12 files that give 2002 its boundary hour.

option_2001.note: Boundary month for 2002; as a campaign year it lacks its own boundary hour.

option_2025.note: Recent complete year; as a campaign year it lacks the 2024-12 boundary hour.

download_rule: Download nothing before explicit user approval of a named stage. Then fetch one sample month per dataset, audit schema, time bounds, units and channel completeness, then the rest; abort if any size or version differs from this list.
caveats: All years are one station (Cabauw); they add weather variation, not independent greenhouse sites.

Older years may differ in instrumentation and in climate from the 2013-2020 development years; the audit reports per-year quality and the plan must say whether formal years are older than development years.
